summary: This audit reviews vlncy.com across seven dimensions. The site is fundamentally healthy: Core Web Vitals pass and best practices score well. The largest opportunities sit in image delivery, accessibility labelling, and AI readiness, where quick wins are available before launch traffic scales.

findings.title: Render-blocking requests
findings.recommendation: Defer or inline critical CSS/JS so first paint is not blocked by external requests.

findings.title: Font display not optimised
findings.recommendation: Add font-display: swap to web font declarations so text renders immediately with a fallback.

findings.title: Forced reflow detected
findings.recommendation: Batch DOM reads and writes; avoid querying layout properties immediately after DOM mutations.

findings.title: Inefficient cache lifetimes
findings.recommendation: Set long Cache-Control max-age headers on static assets with content-hashed filenames.

findings.title: Unoptimised image delivery
findings.recommendation: Serve images in modern formats (WebP/AVIF), compress, and size responsively.

findings.title: Enormous network payload
findings.recommendation: Reduce total transfer size; largest wins are image compression and caching above.

findings.title: Main-thread work too high
findings.impact: 2.3 s of main-thread work, 7 long tasks
findings.recommendation: Split long JavaScript tasks and defer non-critical scripts.

findings.title: Unused CSS and JavaScript
findings.impact: Est savings of 65 KiB CSS + 265 KiB JS
findings.recommendation: Tree-shake and code-split; remove unused rules and legacy polyfills (13 KiB legacy JS).

findings.title: Images missing explicit dimensions
findings.recommendation: Add width and height attributes to all img elements.

findings.title: Images missing alt attributes
findings.impact: Screen readers cannot describe images; also flagged under SEO
findings.recommendation: Add descriptive alt text to all images (34 images affected per full crawl).

findings.title: Insufficient colour contrast
findings.impact: Text may be illegible for low-vision users
findings.recommendation: Adjust foreground/background colours to meet WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1 for body text).

findings.title: Heading order not sequential
findings.impact: Confusing document outline for assistive technology
findings.recommendation: Ensure heading levels descend sequentially (h1 then h2 then h3, no skips).

findings.title: Browser errors logged to console
findings.recommendation: Investigate and resolve console errors logged during page load.
